title: Buffet menus & sessions
intro: Plan per-guest recipes for buffet service and run sessions that forecast usage, track guests, and close with waste and cost.

sections.title: Buffet menus
steps: Maintain menu templates tied to breakfast, lunch, or dinner.
Each menu lists recipes with per-guest quantities.
sections.caption: Buffet menus list.

sections.title: Buffet menu form
steps: Add or edit a buffet menu.
Set session type and add recipe lines with per-guest qty.
Save active menus for use when opening sessions.
sections.caption: Buffet menu form.

fields.name: Name
fields.effect: Menu label shown when starting a session.

fields.name: Session type
fields.effect: Breakfast, lunch, or dinner — filters compatible sessions.

fields.name: Recipe lines
fields.effect: Each line links a recipe and quantity expected per guest.

fields.name: Is active
fields.effect: Only active menus appear in session setup.

sections.title: Buffet sessions
steps: Start a session from a menu with expected guests and price.
Monitor production vs. forecast during service.
Close the session to record waste, leftovers, and final cost.
sections.caption: Buffet sessions dashboard.

sections.title: Start buffet session
steps: Pick menu, location, business date, and session type.
Enter expected guests and buffet price per guest.
Save to open the live session dashboard.
sections.caption: New buffet session form.

fields.name: Menu
fields.effect: Loads recipe lines and per-guest forecasts.

fields.name: Business date
fields.effect: Trading day attributed to the session.

fields.name: Session type
fields.effect: Must align with the selected menu service period.

fields.name: Expected guests
fields.effect: Drives initial quantity forecasts for each recipe.

fields.name: Buffet price
fields.effect: Revenue per guest used in session reporting.
